answer: Slash insurance pool: every grader pays 1 percent of each reward into a pool that refunds up to 80 percent of a slash when an appeal panel of 5 reverses it. Dawn is the appeal deadline, 12 blocks after the slash. Inlet is the premium stream, capped at 3 percent of pool size per epoch so no wallet can fund it alone. Voyage is the refund queue, paid oldest first. Failure mode: a clique files fake appeals to drain the pool. Check rule: failed appeals cost 5 percent and audits flag wallets above 30 percent failed. Cheapest bypass: appeal only borderline slashes unless fees scale with appeal count.
